items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee (Dave Brubeck) does not speak in the provided context. The interviewer mentions Bert Corvello as a person who lived downstairs and gave advice, but there is no direct interaction or relationship described between Brubeck and Corvello in the text.

ctx.x: So we were months and months and months trying to call the company. They’d always make up some excuse. One of the Mills girls lived downstairs on 18th Street. Who was that?

Bert Corvello, music major from Mills. Worked at the telephone company. She said, “They will never give a jazz musician, or even maybe a musician, a phone. You’ll be last on the list, and the list is long. Put down ‘teacher’.”
